walkthrough: Goal: see my practice at a glance, what I did each day and how far I have come, without the app counting the hours it lay open while I did something else, and without days in a row to keep.

Before any practice: on the home the Practice column offers Start (the first lesson) and, at its foot, All units and Practice book. Practice book opens the book: Home at the top left, Practice book in the middle, at the right quietly 0 lessons · 0 min. Below, October as a calendar, Monday first, the 5th ringed: today. Nothing else: nothing done yet. Home goes back.

Monday 5 October: a lesson of Lines at level 1. I copy the first line and compare it, a few minutes at it, Next to the sixth, then Finish. The lesson's end at the right: Lines, 6 exercises and the time, a dot for each, the skill's dots, a vermilion seal stamping down, FIRST STEP (初练 in Chinese). Home: the sheet as it showed, its frames, lines and row label, shrinks into Practice book at the foot of the home's column (where the home keeps every sheet's picture), as an artwork shrinks into its card (S144); never a blank square.

Tuesday 6 October (I left the app overnight): a lesson of Colours at level 1. I pick and fill the first colour after two minutes, compare three minutes later; then I put the tablet down with the app open for two hours. Back, Next to the second colour: I fill it after two minutes, compare a minute later, and go home, the lesson under way.

The book: at the right 1 lesson · 13 min or so. The calendar: the 5th and the 6th each a wash behind its number, the 6th ringed (today). Beside it the colour's first pick as a point with its ΔE × 100 over it, lesson 1's first line with its original in thin see-through red, the FIRST STEP seal. The 6th tapped: its card, a few minutes (the two hours count nothing). The 5th: Lesson 1 · Lines; tapped, its sheet opens, done, its end at the right. Home: the sheet shrinks back into its picture on the 5th's card, the book as I left it, not the home (S158h); Home again for the home.

Wednesday 7 October: Continue (the home's Start while a lesson is under way) continues the colours lesson at Colours 2/3. Next to the third; I fill it, leave the app half an hour (it counts nothing), come back, compare, and Finish.

The book: three days washed, each by its time, 2 lessons; a swipe to the right across the calendar shows September (empty); Later month brings October back. The 7th tapped shows Lesson 2 · Colours (painted over two days, it shows on both) with its colour pairs. The back button goes home.

Thursday 8 October, a busy day (S143): a pack of colour crops imported; a lesson of Key shifts, a fill, Home with it under way; another lesson of Key shifts on a sheet of its own, Finish and One more five times, the sixth left under way; a lesson of Colours on a third sheet, a fill compared, Home with it under way: the part of the sheet on screen, its two frames with their colours, shrinks into Practice book (S144); the column says Colours 1/3 and Continue. The book, the 8th tapped: its card covers the whole right half, progress and its seal hidden under it, nothing sticking out below; its three sheets side by side within the card, each named under its picture within its width: Lesson 3 · Key shifts, Lessons 4–9 · Key shifts (the six on one sheet as their span), Lesson 10 · Colours. A day with more sheets than fit across lays them in further rows, as the path lays its tiles, and the card scrolls once they run past its foot. The third sheet opened, 中文 from Actions, Home: back in the book on the 8th's card, now in Chinese, 第 4 至 9 课 · 变调.

Not here: a colour copy painted over two days and a record from before 1.7.0 timed by its compares (the practice crate's and the store's tests); the 100 lines and 100 colours, ten-session and stage seals (the seals' tests).
